visualContract.layoutPolicy: ComboboxInput wraps InputGroup; its actual native input slot is input-group-control, not an invented combobox-input. Source defaults showTrigger=true/showClear=false, but this reference deliberately composes named exported Trigger and named BaseUI Clear/ChipRemove with tabIndex 0 and showTrigger/showClear/showRemove disabled, because private icon-only wrappers offer no instance label prop. These helpers are transparent caller compositions, not new shadcn exports. Native input/chips frames are 32px with 10px corners; source popup 10px corner/4px inset, standard 28px minimum rows. Chosen 24px chips/6px corners/4px gaps wrap and remain usable at320px. Shared popup surface/InputGroup styles are explicit transitive dependencies; actual SourceList/option/chip/clear styles remain family-specific. Query highlight and selection/open callbacks stay distinct; source native editing, closed-Escape clear, source no-results and filtering rules are preserved. Open dismissal may reset query to the current selected label; only closed Escape performs the separate selected-value clear transaction. Static fixtures keep primitive roles/active-descendant IDs, with Root/Value/Collection/hook context ownership separate from DOM anatomy. Explicit aria-labelledby points to the real native label because source open-state outside hiding can otherwise remove the implicit HTML-label accessible name; a meaningful error text is linked to the input; The reference passes disabled to both Root and ComboboxInput because the wrapper default disabled=false is passed to its rendered InputGroupInput and can otherwise leave the native input enabled despite the Root lock; readOnly and selected arrays retain source behavior. Portal dir/theme and optional chips anchor belong the real Content/Positioner composition, never native specimen coordinates.
